changeSet.comment: search_metadata_scoped / search_aspect_scoped / search_graph_hop at 384, 768 and 1024 (nexus-6pfgb.41, RDR-236 Phase 3): each takes p_manifest_where and p_manifest_path and tests them on the joined row's per-occurrence object (the manifest_search_<dim> object, vectors-045), so a document key or a label key is answered per owning document from the catalog and the hit of the owner that passes is the one returned. The old signatures are dropped and the new ones granted to nexus_svc (a surviving overload breaks the generated .call arity); a post-condition fails the migration unless each name has exactly one signature. No data effect: function definitions and grants only.
